## 06 — Digital Life

Represent personal digital systems as permissioned adapters behind the universal event gateway.

**PHASE 0 ARCHITECTURE MAP** — This workflow documents contracts and status. Architecture nodes are inert and do not call APIs, access credentials, spend funds, send messages, change production, or control hardware.
